items.html: Do not be surprised by that because they are very close to Eretz Israel, as it is written in the Midrash and the Yerushalmi about that man who was plowing with his cow. It ran away from him and he chased it until they reached Bavel before night. Thus, the Guf from Eretz Israel is not far from his Agavot from Bavel, since these are the two upper Prakin proximate to the Guf. The other lower four Prakin in both his Raglaim were from the other lands in Hutz la Eretz.
